anomalies.description: A person in dark clothing is kneeling over another person lying motionless on the ground in a forest, with visible injuries (cut on face, possible wound on arm) and holding a small bouquet of white flowers near the victim's chest—suggesting a post-assault or fatal encounter where the perpetrator remains with the helpless victim.

Multiple men are engaged in a physical struggle around a person wearing a white helmet and racing-style suit; one man in a grey shirt is seen grabbing and restraining the helmeted individual while others assist or intervene.

The helmeted individual appears restrained and overwhelmed by multiple assailants, suggesting a non-consensual, one-sided attack rather than mutual combat; their posture indicates helplessness during the restraint.

A sudden, violent explosion occurs at the metal scaffolding structure, producing a bright flash, a shower of sparks and debris, and rapid expansion of smoke and fire. The structure appears to collapse immediately after the blast.

A large, densely packed crowd of people in a chaotic nighttime setting, with scattered debris (paper, boxes) on the ground, and individuals moving erratically; later frames show uniformed personnel (white helmets, light-colored protective gear) engaging with civilians in close proximity, including physical contact and apparent pushing/shoving near a building entrance.; Persistent chaotic motion, multiple indistinct figures moving violently in rain/steam-lit environment; presence of bright light sources (possibly vehicle headlights or flashlights) and scattered debris suggests group unrest or violent clash.

Direct physical confrontation between uniformed personnel and civilians: in frames f12–f15, individuals in white helmets are seen grabbing, shoving, and physically restraining others in close quarters near a doorway, with visible body contact and forceful motion consistent with mutual or one-sided combat.
Two figures in close proximity with rapid motion blur suggesting physical struggle; one appears to be wearing a light-colored helmet or headgear, and limbs are extended in a combative posture.

A silhouetted figure appears to be forcefully pushing or striking another figure against a vertical surface (e.g., door/window frame); the victim appears passive or restrained, consistent with an attack on a helpless individual.
Two figures engage in close physical combat amidst debris and mist; one figure in dark, glossy attire appears to strike or grapple the other near a corrugated wall.
A silhouetted figure looms over another figure lying or crouched on the ground under bright backlighting, suggesting an attack on a vulnerable individual.
